entities.name: Neurodiversity Movement
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A social movement that frames neurological differences such as autism, ADHD, and dyslexia as natural variations of the human genome rather than disorders to be cured. Coined by Judy Singer in 1998, it advocates for inclusion and accommodation.
